Title: Weight Sorter
Description:
Need to offload some heavy inventory? This adds options to sort inventory and trade screens by weight. It also adds a quick keystroke on each screen to toggle back and forth between modes. 

NOTE: presently works on lang-experimental branch and will work on Diaspora when it goes to EA. *Eventually* should work in main & beta branches, but... not yet!
